articles.title: Social Media Reports and Unverified Allegations
articles.body:
Huang admitted to marital infidelity in a company-wide email, apologizing to his family and employees. Reports linked the controversy to Alice Huang, a former executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed, whom U.S. intelligence officials reportedly suspected of having Chinese intelligence connections. The allegations remain unproven.

As edited photos, AI comparisons, and memes spread across X, NVIDIA's board has launched an independent investigation. The company says it has no evidence that sensitive information was compromised and continues to support Huang's leadership.

articles.title: Unverified Claims in the Digital Age
articles.body:
Social media allows information to spread at extraordinary speed, but speed does not guarantee accuracy. An online post may combine confirmed facts, second-hand reports and unproven allegations. When these elements are presented together, readers may find it difficult to distinguish evidence from speculation.

Images can further complicate the situation. Edited photographs, AI-generated content and humorous memes often travel farther than careful explanations. As a result, the popularity of a claim should not be mistaken for proof of its truth.

Responsible readers should examine the source, look for independent reporting and pay attention to uncertainty. Waiting for reliable evidence is not a sign of indifference. Rather, it reflects a willingness to make judgments fairly and avoid amplifying claims that remain unverified.

questions.stem: What does the author suggest readers do when encountering online claims?

options.text: Accept claims that are widely shared.
Examine sources and wait for reliable evidence.
Ignore all information on social media.
Rely on edited images to confirm the facts.

questions.explanation: 文章末段建议核查来源、寻找独立报道并等待可靠证据，因此选 B。
questions.evidence: Responsible readers should examine the source, look for independent reporting and pay attention to uncertainty.

distractor_analysis.C: 文章主张审慎核查，而非忽视所有信息。
distractor_analysis.D: 编辑过的图像可能造成混淆。

writing_expressions.original_sentence: The popularity of a claim should not be mistaken for proof of its truth.
writing_expressions.essay_sentence: Access to information should not be mistaken for the ability to evaluate it critically.
writing_expressions.translation: 获取信息不应被误认为具备批判性评估信息的能力。
